name: Tidio
description: Tidio is a customer service platform combining live chat, a help desk, and the Lyro AI agent, which can independently handle a large share of repetitive support conversations.
best_for: Ecommerce and support teams that want AI-assisted service alongside a human team and can forecast human-agent conversations, Lyro AI conversations and Flows visitors as three separate monthly quotas.
features: Lyro AI agent for automated conversation handling
Live chat widget for real-time website engagement
Flows automation for lead capture and sales
Integrations with Shopify, WordPress, HubSpot, and Zapier
Native desktop and mobile apps across Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 50 billable conversations/month, 50 one-time Lyro AI conversations, 100 Flows visitors/month.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Starting price, scales with usage. 250+ billable conversations/month, 50+ Lyro AI conversations/month. Marked "Popular".

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Starting price + monthly usage charges on top. Custom conversation limits, dedicated success manager, requires contacting sales for exact pricing.

cons: Above the Free plan, pricing scales with conversation volume rather than being a flat per-tier price -- Growth and Plus are both "starting at" prices that increase with usage.

The monthly billable-conversation quota is pooled across agent-handled live chat, tickets/email and Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp conversations (Lyro and Flows have separate quotas). Once it is reached, agents cannot reply or see incoming message details until the quota resets or the plan is upgraded.
The Free plan's Lyro AI allotment (50 conversations) is one-time, not monthly -- ongoing AI automation requires a paid tier.

alternatives.name: Intercom
alternatives.description: A customer messaging platform combining live chat, help desk, and AI-powered support agents.
alternatives.best_for: SaaS companies wanting conversational, in-app customer engagement.

alternatives.name: Crisp
alternatives.description: An all-in-one support platform combining live chat, AI agents, and a shared inbox.
alternatives.best_for: Startups to enterprises wanting a lightweight, chat-first support tool.

alternatives.name: LiveAgent
alternatives.description: An all-in-one help desk merging email, chat, phone, and social into one dashboard.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses handling multiple channels wanting fast live chat.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation
